abstractEnglish: For the Thorp shuffle on $`2^d`$ cards, we prove that the worst-start total-variation distance after $`32800d`$ physical shuffles tends to zero as $`d\to\infty`$. Combining our fixed-list estimate with the companion Fourier transfer improves this bound to $`512d`$ shuffles. These results follow from bounds on partially observed permutation laws in random coordinate frames.
